purpose: Canonical direct-relationship map for The Crew Blueprint. Crew Blueprint points outward only to Production Atlas, 50yearroadmap, and Roadmapdev. Deadhang Labor LLC is represented as the owner/parent relationship, but that ownership edge does not create a business-intelligence or operational-data feed into Crew Blueprint.

systems.crew_blueprint_data_rule: Ownership metadata and owner-authorized governance direction may cross this edge when necessary. Deadhang financials, procurement, vendor/client data, pricing, insurance strategy, market strategy, sourcing methods, operating intelligence, and other private commercial data do not flow into Crew Blueprint curriculum or learner-facing systems.

systems.role: separate employment and hiring intelligence destination

systems.crew_blueprint_ingress_rule: Only learner-domain research grounded in admissible educational sources may flow from Roadmapdev into Crew Blueprint. Hiring/market intelligence, Deadhang business intelligence, procurement research, pricing, financial, competitive, client, vendor, or operating-strategy research is prohibited from Crew Blueprint ingress.

allowed_use: minimal legal or governance metadata required to represent ownership
prohibited_use: Deadhang sourcing methods or operating intelligence
using ownership as authority to import private commercial data into learner content

allowed_use: send a learner to a separate job-search or hiring-information destination
prohibited_use: copy Atlas data into Crew Blueprint
use Atlas data as curriculum evidence
use Atlas hiring or market data to shape course claims or assessments
embed employer, pay, vacancy, market, labor-route, worker-review, or demand datasets in Crew Blueprint
treat Atlas as a Crew Blueprint research dependency
turn Crew Blueprint into Deadhang business intelligence
merge learner data with private commercial strategy

allowed_use: learner-domain gap analysis based only on admissible educational evidence
direct_relations.admission_gate: Must satisfy AGENTS.md section 4.0 Permanent source-domain firewall before use.

non_relations.rule: No direct Crew Blueprint relationship. Marketstrategy research cannot enter Crew Blueprint curriculum or learner-facing research.
Not a direct Crew Blueprint edge. Any durable-state synchronization is infrastructure behind the governed 50yearroadmap/Roadmapdev contract and does not create a new content-source relationship.

allowed: statutes, regulations, and official agency guidance
recognized consensus standards, including applicable ANSI material
manufacturer manuals, technical bulletins, and model-specific documentation
clearly labeled practitioner knowledge when appropriate and when no stronger source exists
prohibited: Deadhang Labor LLC business/financial/procurement/vendor/client/pricing/insurance/market-strategy/operating intelligence beyond minimal ownership/governance metadata
mixed packages that have not been split before admission

course_claim_or_learning_question: roadmapdev:learner-domain research only after source-domain admission check
